name: lading
description: Archive a file onto Arweave, Walrus and Filecoin in one call, paid in USDC on Base, with a signed bill of lading named on ArNS.
long_description: Lading is an archive broker on the TOON mesh. This extension gives Claude seven tools: show the payer wallet, describe the gate, quote a put, check whether a file is already archived, archive a file or text of any size (paid per 1 MiB part above 3 MiB, free again for bytes the gate already holds), verify a bill of lading by its ArNS name, and renew a Walrus record (paid). Payment is x402 over USDC on Base from a key this extension generates on first run at ~/.lading/x402.key; ask Claude to run lading_wallet for the address to fund. Every paid call is quoted first and refused above the per-call cap. No ETH is ever needed.

tools.name: lading_wallet
tools.description: Free. The payer address, its USDC balance on Base, and how to fund it.

tools.name: lading_describe
tools.description: Free. What the gate sells, prices, network, payTo.

tools.name: lading_quote
tools.description: Free. USDC price to archive an object of a given size.

tools.name: lading_lookup
tools.description: Free. Whether the gate already holds a bill of lading for a file, text or sha256, and the record if so.

tools.name: lading_put
tools.description: Paid. Archive a file or text on Arweave, Walrus and Filecoin with a named bill of lading. Bytes the gate already holds come back free.

tools.name: lading_verify
tools.description: Free. Re-fetch every leg of a bill of lading and compare sha256.

tools.name: lading_renew
tools.description: Paid. One more year on Walrus for a record this gate uploaded.

gate.title: Lading gate URL
gate.description: The hosted door to pay. Leave the default unless you run your own gate.

max_usdc.title: Cap per paid call (USDC)
max_usdc.description: Any put or renewal quoted above this is refused before paying.

key.title: Base private key (optional)
key.description: Leave empty: a key is generated at ~/.lading/x402.key on first run. Paste a 0x hex key only to pay from a wallet you already hold.
